regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, non-directional rotation: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible, led by Banks (crowded, mean-revert texture) with Energy as the not-yet-crowded momentum challenger. The absolute-trend gate has helped this market historically (gate_helps=true), but nearly every theme carries hurst_tag 'trend' or 'mixed' at low durability bars — leadership is thin and not confirmed by breadth of rotation ('narrow'). All themes shown have etf_proxy=null (not scorable) except the bottom-ranked Tech themes, so there is very little accountable surface. No high-conviction direction is supported.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) can build breadth above 0.75 AND hold its trend-gate eligibility while Banks (H + HK) stays crowded/mean-revert — that combination would describe a confirmed leadership handoff from crowded Banks to not-crowded trend-clean Energy. Retire the watch if Energy's crowding_z rises above 1.0 or its breadth falls back below 0.6 before any such handoff completes.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only eligible theme (trend-gate passed) with a strongly positive score, a durability_bar above its own threshold, breadth 0.70, hurst_tag 'trend' (the only leading theme with clean trend texture), and crucially NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.18). It is the one leg of the detector that combines the validated eligibility gate with trend coherence and no crowding flag. Momentum rank itself is not alpha, so this is directional only to the extent that the trend gate plus absence of crowding describes which leadership is currently staying-power viable.
evidence: hurst_tag: trend; durability_bar 0.72 > 0.65 and above its own bar; breadth 0.70
crowding_z 0.18 — not crowded (one of the few leaders with a valid tail-risk profile)
rotation challenger: Energy, margin to leader 0.465
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is thin breadth (0.70) and the regime overall is 'narrow' with directional=false; H-share energy is highly sensitive to a single commodity/capex story and mean-reverts hard when the China reflation trade pauses. The trend gate has no mean-return edge — it only avoids left tail, so overweight here is a de-risking preference, not a return call.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) loses trend-gate eligibility (eligible flips false) or breadth drops below 0.5 before the 20-day check.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is the lowest/most negative eligible-adjacent theme with hurst_tag 'trend' but breadath only 0.167 and score -1.067, meaning participation is broken and the trend leg is detached from the theme. It fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible: false) and sits at the bottom of the momentum ranks. The one validated edge — the trend gate — explicitly says stay out when a theme is not eligible, and this one is not.
evidence: breadth 0.167 — theme is essentially dead from a cross-sectional participation standpoint
hurst_tag 'trend' with near-zero breadth indicates solo-mover behavior, not theme leadership
scorable proxy absent for this specific theme
theses.dissent: A single large index heavyweight can carry this theme mechanically even with zero breadth; a policy/capex surprise in China semis could re-rate the whole group quickly and the avoidance leg has no positive return edge. Avoid only means don't allocate, not that it will fall.

falsifier.text: Tech Hardware & Semis flips to eligible=true AND breadth exceeds 0.6 before the 30-day check.
